How Toy Story 5 & Dug Days Artists Joined Pixar Story | The Pixar Show
The Pixar Show is BACK with another exclusive short film: One Shot Productions!! Plus, interviews with Pixar Storyboard artists Charles Choo and Alex Pimwong -- story artists who worked on Toy Story 5, Luca, Dug Days -- and their unusual paths to joining the Story department at Pixar Animation Studios! Don't miss the premiere of Toy Story 5 on Disney+, coming September 23, 2026!
